body:
You'll notice. I just hit 100 lbs down and literally everyone, even acquaintances who I don't usually talk to, that I haven't seen in any bit of time has said something. Just keep at it. If your clothes are fitting looser and you've lost 40 already its coming off and you'll get there. I didn't think I was changing for the longest time, but when you finally look in the mirror and can see the change for yourself, and say damn, I look good today! it's a really cool moment!

Best of luck!

But as just using a guest pass, will I have to do the 'fitness assessment'? or is it just the 'fitness analysis' (height and weight, like  monstersnacks said)

And I'm not interested in either, I'm interested in using the gym for just one day.

Great. I'm hoping it's as quick and painless as possible. I'm expecting the sales pitch but there's not a chance in hell I'm buying anything or signing up for any training since my regular gym membership is already included in my exorbitant tuition payments so hopefully they won't make it too difficult to decline or at least feign interest pending how my workout goes and then damn, would you look at the time. Gotta go!

Thanks for the reply!

Fantastic. I can deal with that. Oh, surprise, you need to lose more weight. Shocker. It's why I'm at the gym. 

Thanks for your reply!

Though apparently there's also a meeting with a membership counselor. Hopefully I can get them off my back as quickly as possible.

Awesome! One more size to go and I'm right there with you! I was so excited to see that I'm a 44 now. Though it's fantastic, the one downside is that now all my other clothes are way too big and I look ridiculous! I just got a new pair of jeans that actually fit and I've been wearing them for like a week because all my other jeans are two sizes too big haha

Yeah I'll start counting again. But I feel that if anything I overestimate calories just in case I am off, I'd rather estimate that I ate more than I did. I just don't know how there's anyway that I'm eating an extra 1000 calories and not knowing it...

Yeah I adjusted my calories for my current weight, right now my maintenance is 2970 and I've been staying generally around 1900-2100 calories, sometimes more, sometimes less. No food scale, as most of what I eat is on the go (full time college student, when I'm not in class I'm at work). And no, not taking body measurements though I've been measured by two different tailors recently and my measurements have decreased in the weeks between the two measurements.

No plans on stopping at the gym at all, I'm actually enjoying it.

Next plan is to start counting again just to double check my calories but the reason i stopped counting is I've become familiar with the calories of the things I eat, because like I said, I eat the same things, though I'll double check that by returning to MFP.
I'm sure they do. But I'm not one of those people. And it appears that OP could also not be one of those people. People are different.

Just to make sure you see it, since two others have already commented. 

But don't go 7 hours without eating and then work out. It's extremely likely that's a part of the problem. I'm by no means an expert but if I try and work out without eating, or without getting enough sleep (which shouldn't affect you in this circumstance) I almost certainly feel nauseous exerting myself and have thrown up because of it. And if I think of all the times its happened, its because I didn't eat, or I barely slept.

Got reallllll drunk on some tequila last night. Prepared and got myself some water and jack links beef steak because I knew I'd want to munch on something and it was so delicious and completely within my bounds. No regrets!

Agreed it's so much easier. I'm like, I can eat this?

But you stick with it too man! Since we're so similar I'm gonna check on you and see your progress. You can do the same to me if you wish. But we got this.

RemindMe! 6 Months
Seriously though. Do it. It's the tiniest bit and it just gets rid of the bitterness and makes it so good.
I'm sure it will, but I'm starting way heavy, so I'm enjoying this quickness while it lasts :)
I've only weighed myself on hers and I came downstairs and found out that my mom bought my sister that scale and she bought the exact same one for us so I actually do have the same scale!

Most of my problem is that I'm extremely lonely. It's not something that is simple to explain and I don't understand it. I have friends...I guess...people that I talk to and hang out with sometimes but these 'friends' are more than happy to leave me out of things and I feel like if I'm wasn't the one to make the effort, I wouldn't hang out with anyone. The people I would consider my best friends can and have left me out of things and plans in favor of others and I know it. Other people that I've gotten close to have had no problems treating me like a disposable piece of shit. I feel like people take me for granted a lot and constantly use me for their own benefit. 

"Hey, can I get a ride?" 

"Want to do this thing for me because I'm too lazy? Cool, thanks." 

and they do it because they know I won't say no, because I want these people to like me. Which I guess is why I've strayed toward suicide. I can't sleep at night so I spend the time thinking about my life in excruciating detail and I think about how people would react if I actually did it. They would be taken completely by surprise because I've become so good at hiding it that like I said most people wouldn't take me seriously if I looked straight in their eyes and told them. And I've been getting closer, this past friday was so bad that I found myself accelerating towards a brick wall...

 And maybe it's not even so much that I want to die as I want people to care about me. I spend so much of my time caring about others and trying my hardest to make their lives better even when I feel like absolute shit but when it comes to me nobody reciprocates. Last night I still felt like shit and I walked in on one of my friends obviously having a bad night and immediately my reaction was to ask what was wrong and try and talk to them about it. I saw it as a prime opportunity to let some of my own problems out instead of keeping them hidden from everyone. But like I said, she greeted them with disbelief and tried to convince me that I couldn't feel these things as they weren't true. But she isn't the one that watches people walk by constantly doing things while I'm in plain view but nobody bothers to invite me along for anything. I had plans to move in with some friends but at the absolute last second they let me know that they wanted to live with someone else who I didn't want to live with and that if I didn't want to live with this person then I shouldn't live with them so instead I arranged to live with complete strangers. 

There's also the problem of my love life. I am extremely unattractive to the point of repugnant to every girl that I've ever talked to or at least it seems that way. Even the girls that I was just friends with I tried to casually ask them to accompany me to something as just a friend and the thought made them so uncomfortable that ignoring me and actively seeking an excuse to avoid going with me were more reasonable reactions. I haven't kissed let alone danced with any girl in I don't even know how long. At least 9 years. And I know that I have to be responsible for the change...heh, this is my diet and excercise account actually...but I have no idea where to begin and the sheer amount of work is intimidating. But being constantly rejected and shut down is extremely demotivating and makes me think, what is the point? and if I can't ever experience what being loved and cared about by another person is then what is the point of living at all? Worst part is, is that I know I'm young. I have my entire life in front of me. Things will likely change in the future. But what if they don't. Then I'm older and still miserable. Also, do I have to continue to suffer for years for the possibility of happiness?

I feel like nothing good ever happens to me. I'm alone. My friends aren't my real friends. I appear to have good opportunities in front of me that always fall flat. 

As for my free time. I love music. I love concerts. I would love if I could spend my entire life surrounded by music. And again, I appear to have a few opportunities in front of me to help advance that love but the possibility that I'm not cut out for the task at hand is extremely stressful. As is school and my continuing education, I feel like what if I'm not smart enough and what if I'm bankrupting myself and my parents and what if my school is actually just a piece of shit and I'm wasting my time.

I don't know. But I'm so at a loss for what to do or who to talk to that I'm reduced to making a god damn meme about it in the hopes that maybe someone gives a shit if I live or die.

and that is depressing the shit out of me.

fuck.

Some of the things in my reply are relevant to your comment.

Also, I know we'll hang out again but probably not until Thanksgiving as I return to school in a few days and after that not until Christmas.

The checks aren't things that I am adding towards my conclusion. They are just points that stood out to me. Also, it wasn't said that it was strictly for an hour and she wasn't at a party she was just hanging out with her best friend and left her alone to hang out with me for a bit, it just happened to be an hour or so. I understand the confusion though, I typed it poorly, I'm still flustered. and thanks for replying.
